findings.text: blocking: the receipt wrapper still constructs ForwardSolveReceipt with mask_history=mask_history and passes no support_cell_count, but solve_request.py:733-734 renamed the field and made support_cell_count required, so every receipt this runtime app builds raises TypeError; the done_when requires every reader updated and this one is neither changed nor named in outside_scope.

blocking: the labeller batch shard builds ForwardSolveReceipt(mask_history=differences) with no support_cell_count, so every sharded receipt raises TypeError at construction; the path is outside the write fence but is not recorded under outside_scope, so the widen request the brief demands was never raised for it.

non-blocking: measure_branches reads receipt.mask_history, an attribute that no longer exists, so the measurement path raises AttributeError; it is unnamed in outside_scope and needs the same mechanical rename to changed_mask_entries.
non-blocking: the diagnostic prints receipt.mask_history, which the rename removed, so it raises AttributeError on any run; it is unnamed in outside_scope.

blocking: nothing asserts the receipt's new fields, so a regression that published changed_mask_entries as support_cell_count at forward.py:2753-2774 - the exact confusion the node exists to end - would leave tests/test_forward_solve_request.py:142 (name tuple only) and tests/test_receipt_support_count.py:100 (FixedPointResult, not the receipt) green; the negative control mutated the loop, not this publication.

non-blocking: the expected value is built from SUPPORT_CELLS, the same constant that constructs the input labels at line 36, so the assertion compares the count of CORE labels handed to the solver against a number derived from those labels rather than an independent source; negative-control.log shows it nevertheless reddens on the targeted mutation, so it is a real guard for this defect but a weak one for any other count that happens to equal the CORE population.

item_verdicts.call_sites: four production readers were checked: apps/playable/session.py:432 and scripts/labeller_batch/shard.py:354 construct the receipt, scripts/prototypes/diiid_forward_convergence/measure_branches.py:351 and scripts/prototypes/diiid_stopping_rule/diagnose_step_gate.py:102 read the removed attribute; nova/equilibrium/forward.py:2765 is the only producer and was updated.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when requires a test asserting support_cell_count > 0 while changed_mask_entries reaches 0, a red negative control, and a dated correction in the stopping-rule fragment; tests/test_receipt_support_count.py:95-104 asserts the pair on FixedPointResult rather than on ForwardSolveReceipt, negative-control.log records the red run, and docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-stopping-rule-fix.html:231-266 carries the correction.

justifications.durability: the negative control proves tests/test_receipt_support_count.py:103 reddens when the loop publishes the change count, but no test reads receipt.support_cell_count or receipt.changed_mask_entries, so swapping the two arrays at nova/equilibrium/forward.py:2753-2774 leaves the suite green.
justifications.evidence: gate-final.log and after-suite.log both record 8 passed EXIT=0 at 3294d1017 and negative-control.log records 3 failed EXIT=1 with three named ids, but the assertions at tests/test_receipt_support_count.py:100-103 read FixedPointResult.active_set_support_cells rather than the receipt field the goal names, so the forward.py:2753-2774 publication is not what the gate measures.
justifications.fit: the added names changed_mask_entries, support_cell_count and active_set_support_cells describe the quantity and the helpers at nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:4652-4661 follow the adjacent partition_difference idiom, with no plan or ticket labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py:733-734 renames the field and adds support_cell_count, and nova/equilibrium/forward.py:2745-2774 populates both from the loop, but the done_when's 'update every reader in the repository' is unmet: apps/playable/session.py:432 and scripts/labeller_batch/shard.py:354 still construct ForwardSolveReceipt with mask_history= and no support_cell_count, and scripts/prototypes/diiid_forward_convergence/measure_branches.py:351 reads receipt.mask_history.
justifications.reuse: no owner for a per-trip axis-connected support count exists in nova/equilibrium/domain.py; the addition reads _FrozenTopologyPartition.label (nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:801) the same way nova/equilibrium/forward.py:1632 already selects CORE.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 708079d2e5c7..3294d101740f lists exactly the six declared write paths and no others; the omitted readers are a goal gap recorded at apps/playable/session.py:432, not an out-of-scope edit.
